messages:
Maria: Vendor RMA update — H100 batch 12 arrived with 4/40 DOA at depot, customs put a hold in FRA due to HS code mismatch. Vendor proposes split fulfillment: 2 units air express, 2 units sea. Need decision on expedite cost vs accept split. AWB (current hold): 1Z999AA10123456784. @tyler can we cover expedite from contingency? @vendor-ops please confirm air ETA and crossdock options.
Tyler: If we air everything it's ~48-72h but +$14k. Contingency only has about $10k left. Ops perspective: we should prioritize the two production nodes. Suggest air for hot units, sea for the rest.
Chen: Can we air-ship only the thermal-critical serials? S/Ns in prod: H100-AAA-0012, H100-AAA-0014. The other two are staging spares.
vendor-ops: From vendor: can confirm air ETA 2.5 days for 2 units; sea ETA 9-11 days for the remainder. We can crossdock in FRA and submit corrected paperwork for €850 to speed customs clearance. Air AWB: `EZ123456789DE` (tracking live). Important: commercial invoice needs HS code 8471.80 to avoid reclassification. Per SLA we'll cover 50% of expedite surcharge; vendor estimates ~$7k contribution.
Maria: Ok planning: air the two prod units, crossdock + sea for the spares. @logistics-bot please raise PO and assign charge code for the surcharge.
logistics-bot: PO created: PO-78945, charge code INFRA-EXP-21, estimated vendor surcharge $7,000 (vendor covers half per SLA). Finance notified.
Tyler: :thumbsup: I'll open an infra incident to prioritize replacement pods. @Chen confirm node drain schedule.
Chen: Starting node drain now, maintenance window in 30m. Swap ETA: nodes back up ~2.5h after hardware swap + validation.
Maria: Vendor also flagged a serial mismatch on one return label — depot will attach temp tag to avoid customs hold. They may ask for photo evidence. I have photos on the tracker.
vendor-ops: Confirmed tag flow at depot. If customs requests additional paperwork we'll reissue corrected CI immediately. Keep this thread updated so we can avoid requeueing the AWB.
Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll update the RMA tracker (spreadsheet + JIRA RMA-4821) and add notes to the ops runbook for the expedited recovery path.
